decision.what: A card's page address stays /framework/ai/YYYY/MM/DD/<slug>/ (the Inbox route, inside the Inbox shell); only its FOLDER moves to ai/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/cards/<slug>/, and every reader turns an id into that folder through one class, ai/cards/CardDir.js (Servex Cards.dir(id) adds the old-folder fallback). The 656 records carrying card ids and every old card link keep answering with no redirect.
decision.alternative: make the store url the card's page and redirect the old route; rejected because the card page needs the Inbox shell (rail, composer) that the sessions store page does not have.

decision.what: Card moves go in their own ledger, ai/sessions/card-moves.jsonl (+ card-moves-files.jsonl), via a new TaskMove --manifest mode. The card address is a formula, so no browser needs the log to redirect, and StoreFolder's synchronous fetch of task-moves.jsonl does not grow by 660 lines.
decision.alternative: the shared task-moves.jsonl, as next.md suggested.
